span: However, due to linkage disequilibrium (LD), it is challenging to distinguish causal cis-molQTLs from tagging variants within a genomic region. Previous efforts have demonstrated that leveraging the heterogeneity of LD and minor allele frequency (MAF) across diverse ancestries improves the precision of statistical fine-mapping and therefore enhances our biological understanding of molecular traits4.

span: First, many approaches do not model the correlation of causal variant effect sizes across ancestries or assume that they are a-priori independent across ancestries, which fails to reflect shared or similar genetic architectures5–7.
